# prsnn

> prsnn is an app for booking a verified companion for platonic company in public places: someone to go to an event with, show you around a new city, study beside you, or spend time with a parent who's alone. It launched in Hyderabad, India, and was founded by Mukarram Jah.

## Key facts

- What it is: a mobile app (iOS and Android) that connects members who want company for everyday plans with approved companions. Company is strictly platonic; prsnn is not a dating or escort service.
- Where: Hyderabad, India (launch city).
- Founder: Mukarram Jah. He built prsnn after his grandfather, who had dementia, went missing for seven days; the question it answers is "When we can't be there for the people we love, who can we trust to be there for them?"
- Safety: every companion is approved by the prsnn team and verifies a government ID with a selfie before their first booking; every meeting is at a public place named in the booking, except home visits that a family books for a loved one; phone numbers are hidden in chat; a panic button alerts the prsnn team at once and every five minutes until resolved.
- Prices (fixed, same for every companion, no booking fee): 1 hour ₹399, 2 hours ₹699, 3 hours ₹999, 4 hours ₹1,299, 5 hours ₹1,599, 6 hours ₹1,899, 7 hours ₹2,199, 8 hours ₹2,499, 9 hours ₹2,799, 10 hours ₹3,099, 11 hours ₹3,349, 12 hours ₹3,599.
- Refunds: full refund if no companion accepts or if the companion cancels; 85% if the member cancels at least 15 minutes before the start.
- Companions keep 80% of every booking (e.g. ₹1,039 for a 4-hour booking).
- Support: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}

## Kinds of company

- New in Town: a first walk around a new neighbourhood, finding cafés and weekend spots, help with practical errands, company for first visits to the city's sights.
- Don't Go Alone: concerts, stand-up, weddings, parties, movies, dinners, festivals and matches when friends can't make it.
- Explore & Discover: heritage walks, food trails, markets, museums and trying something new with a local.
- Companion for a Loved One: a warm visit to a parent or grandparent (at their home if the family asks), walks at their pace, errands and family functions, booked and paid by family from anywhere, including abroad.
- Work & Study Together: café co-working, library study sessions, exam prep and accountability.
